title: Study on Post-acute Myocardial Infarction Ventricular Defect: Outcome Evalutation in Relation to Surgical Timing
official: Multicenter Study on Post-acute Myocardial Infarction Ventricular Defect: Outcome Evalutation in Relation to Surgical Timing
summary: The main objective of the study is to identify the optimal surgical timing for the treatment of intraventricular defects after acute myocardial infarction.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over eighteen years of age
* Patients with post-myocardial infarction ventricular septal defect treated surgically
* Patients who have signed the informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with post-infarction ventricular septal defect treated with medical/conservative therapy
* Patients with ventricular septal defects not due to acute myocardial infarction
